changeSet.author: Puneet
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[ResponsibilitySummary] AS select RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, r.ApplyToType, RES.ResourceID from responsibilitytyperelationrule r inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (r.ID = rasset.RuleID) inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.ID = rresource.RuleID) inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = rresource.SecurityAssetID and rresource.SecurityAsset = 'R' where RES.State=1 union All select RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, rasset.AssetID, rasset.AssetTypeID, r.ApplyToType, RES.ResourceID from responsibilitytyperelationrule r inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultAsset] rasset on (r.ID = rasset.RuleID) inner join [ResponsibilityRuleResultSecurityAsset] rresource on (r.ID = rresource.RuleID) inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = r.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [Group] G on rresource.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = rresource.SecurityAssetID inner join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID where RES.State=1 union all select RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, oride.AssetID, att.ID as AssetTypeID, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, RES.ResourceID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = oride.SecurityAssetID and oride.SecurityAsset = 'R' and RES.State = 1 union all select RT.Uid as ResponsibilityTypeUid, RT.ID as ResponsibilityTypeID, oride.AssetID, att.ID as AssetTypeID, cast(0 as bit) as ApplyToType, RES.ResourceID from [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] oride inner join ResponsibilityType RT on RT.ID = oride.ResponsibilityTypeID inner join [dbo].asset a on (a.id = oride.assetID) inner join [dbo].assettype att on (att.id = a.assettypeid) inner join [Group] G on oride.SecurityAsset = 'G' and G.ID = oride.SecurityAssetID inner join ResourceGroup RG on RG.GroupID = G.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource RES on RES.ResourceID = RG.ResourceID and RES.[State] = 1
